title: Ep 8 — Anthropic's six-billion-dollar video bet, and the FAQ chatbot earning three hundred thousand a year
description: Anthropic reportedly negotiates a six-billion-dollar acquisition of video-AI startup Decart, Lovable's no-code builder doubles to a thirteen-billion-dollar valuation in eight months, and xAI's Grok four point six lands inside Cursor on day one. Plus a deep dive on UK-founded chatbot My Ask AI, which reportedly reached three hundred thousand dollars a year, and the Fundraising Regulator quietly pushes its prize-draw ruling from September twenty twenty-six to early twenty twenty-seven.
